items.title: 33.7.2 Efficient Use of Water (pani ka kifayat se istemal) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Aaj ke daur mein water conservation (pani bachana) bohat zaroori hai, kyun ke duniya ki aabadi ka bara hissa pani ki kami ka saamna kar raha hai. Yeh tareeqe pani bachane mein madad dete hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “a large pollution fraction of the world” likhti hai; yahan “pollution” ki jagah “population” (aabadi) hona chahiye: duniya ki aabadi ka bara hissa pani ki kami ka saamna karta hai.

items: Kheti mein pani bachane wali technology, jaise drip irrigation (qatra qatra pani) aur sprinkler irrigation (phuar), water wastage (pani ka zaya hona) bohat kam karti hai aur crop yield (fasal ki paidawar) aur efficiency (kaarkardagi) barhati hai.

Greywater, yani gharon mein kapre dhone, bartan dhone aur nahane ka pani, ko dobara istemal (reuse) aur recycle karna: landscaping (baghbani), toilet flushing aur industrial cooling (industry mein thanda karna) ke liye. Is se freshwater resources (meethe pani ke zakhire) bachte hain aur sewage treatment systems par bojh kam hota hai.

Urban (shehri) aur rural (dehi) dono ilaqon mein rainwater harvesting systems (barish ka pani jama karne ke system) lagana, qeemti pani pakarne aur store karne ka sustainable (der tak chalne wala) tareeqa hai.

Water supply infrastructure (pani ki supply ke pipes aur system) ki regular repair (ba-qaida marammat) aur maintenance (dekh-bhaal) se leaks aur water loss (pani ka zaya hona) kam hote hain, aur pani theek tarah pohanchta hai.

Chhote dam aur recharge wells (zameen mein pani wapas bhejne wale kuen) banana barish ka pani jama karta aur groundwater levels (zameen ke neeche ke pani ki sateh) dobara bharta hai, taake dry periods (khushk mausam) mein bhi pani mile.

Community engagement (logon ki shirakat) aur awareness (aagahi): pani bachane ki aadaton par public education campaigns (awaam ke liye taleemi muhimmein), aur local communities (maqami logon) ko water bodies ki hifazat mein shamil karna.

blocks.prompt: Pani bachane ke chaar tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi chaar: drip ya sprinkler irrigation; greywater ka dobara istemal; rainwater harvesting; leak ki marammat; chhote dam aur recharge wells; awareness campaigns.

items: Drip aur sprinkler irrigation; greywater ka dobara istemal; rainwater harvesting; leak ki marammat; chhote dam aur recharge wells; aagahi.
